mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit_log (user_id, ip, path, referer, user_agent, device) VALUES (#{userId}, #{ip}, #{path}, #{referer}, #{userAgent}, #{device})

where.if: AND (v.ip LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT v.*, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname FROM visit_log v LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = v.user_id
ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit_log) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit_log WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayPv, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ip) FROM visit_log WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayUv, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit_log WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL) AS memberCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit_log WHERE user_id IS NULL) AS guestCount

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS uv FROM visit_log WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN referer IS NULL OR referer = '' THEN '直接访问 / 书签' WHEN referer LIKE '%baidu%' THEN '百度' WHEN referer LIKE '%google.%' THEN 'Google' WHEN referer LIKE '%bing.%' THEN '必应' WHEN referer LIKE '%github%' THEN 'GitHub' WHEN referer LIKE '%weixin%' OR referer LIKE '%wechat%' THEN '微信' ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(referer, '://', -1), '/', 1), ':', 1) END AS source, COUNT(*) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS uv FROM visit_log GROUP BY source ORDER BY pv DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM visit_log WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
